writeup: TIC 59490510 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 9.1248 days. The system shows a primary eclipse that dims the light by 32.99 percent, and a secondary eclipse was detected at 9.7 sigma significance. The Box Least Squares detection signal-to-noise ratio of 1068.4 indicates strong periodicity in TESS photometry data. Pixel-level difference imaging confirms the signal at the target location with a peak signal-to-noise of 38.7, though the centroid offset of 3.2 arcsec warrants attention. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, and the machine learning screening score of 0.82 suggests high likelihood of a genuine astrophysical source. All data quality checks passed without flags.
